blockers.detail: Existing Scout/Beta evidence strongly supports demand, backlog, operating momentum, strategic relevance, bottleneck and execution-risk factors, but a complete Alpha score still requires source-addressed governance/capital-allocation, supply-chain, pricing-power and defensible valuation/asymmetry evidence. Current market source was changed from prior primary-only attempts to a lawful current market-data source; this reduced valuation uncertainty but did not support the full twelve-component record without manufactured values.

sourcePathsAttempted: fresh lawful current market valuation source
learning.failedStrategy: relying on cumulative primary operating evidence to support components it does not directly address
learning.changedStrategy: added a materially different current market-data source class for valuation; next run should target 2026 proxy/governance and issuer/SEC supply-chain and contract-pricing disclosures
learning.nextLawfulAction: Acquire 2026 proxy/governance evidence plus primary supply-chain/pricing disclosures, then calibrate all twelve components only if every value has exact sourceIds. Continue to NOW/NTLA/NTR independently if NOC remains uncloseable.
